title: Money and an inequality penalty
hook: Two stated cases: explore the difference between cash and model utility.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the difference between cash and model utility affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Utility, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the difference between cash and model utility in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
